---
name: What next
about: A review after a release, of what to improve next and what to leave alone, for the owner to decide
---

## Decisions asked

<With the `maintaining-a-product` skill. Each decision the owner is asked
for, with the recommendation: the next increment, what to leave alone, the
known limitations to add or remove, a redraw of the districts when the
evidence shows one, and a verdict on the product when the evidence raises
one.>

## Outcomes

<Each outcome check due since the last review: its measures against its
criterion, and whether it was met. Each check still pending, with what it
needs. Each watched feature: its measures against its bar for stable,
linked from its issue, and whether to call it stable. The brief's success
criteria, measured. In a project with districts, each district's production
measures against their values at the last review, or as the baseline at the
first.>

## Open work

<Crises first. Open bugs with their cost; `debt` issues with the planned
work each one slows; open Dependabot alerts and pull requests; each rule in
the brief's Constraints last read more than six months before, read again;
the files changed most since the last review; ideas, `later` issues and
feedback; in a project with districts, the open issues
by district, and those with no district label, with the district proposed
for each, and, from git history since the last review, the districts that
changed together and those that didn't change; findings, summarised with
nothing private in them.>

## Looking back

<The guidelines review lines raised more than once, the owner's comments
made more than once, minor findings and postmortems since the last review.
Each lesson kept, and where it goes.>

## The next increment

<One change or a few, in order, each with what it gains, its risk and its
appetite.>

## Left alone

<Each item not taken now, with its reason.>

## Decided

<Once the owner decides: each decision, the items sent on to gate 1, and
the checks carried to the next review.>
